terms.title: Adoption
terms.summary: Adoption describes the rate at which people, partners, and institutions begin using SORA products, liquidity, and governance tooling in real-world contexts.

terms.title: Analytics
terms.summary: Analytics covers the dashboards, telemetry, and research teams tracking SORA network health, liquidity depth, bridge flow, and ecosystem growth.

terms.title: Blockchain
terms.summary: A distributed ledger technology that maintains a continuously growing list of records secured using cryptography.

terms.title: Bonding Curve
terms.summary: A smart contract that manages the supply of XOR in a rational way without human involvement.

terms.title: Bridges
terms.summary: Bridges are interoperability protocols that move assets and data between SORA and external chains so liquidity can circulate without centralized custodians.

terms.title: Council
terms.summary: A governance body in SORA's current Polkadot v1 governance system that consists of elected members who can propose referenda and veto dangerous proposals.

terms.title: Cross Chain
terms.summary: The ability to transfer assets and data between different blockchain networks.

terms.title: Decentralization
terms.summary: Decentralization is the principle of distributing power across validators, councils, and citizens so no single entity can control the SORA economy.

terms.title: DeFi
terms.summary: Decentralized Finance - financial services built on blockchain networks that operate without traditional financial intermediaries.

terms.title: DEX
terms.summary: Decentralized Exchange - a cryptocurrency exchange that operates without a central authority, allowing users to trade directly with each other through smart…

terms.title: Economics
terms.summary: Economics in the SORA context refers to monetary policy, incentives, and treasury allocation that keep XOR supply, liquidity, and funding balanced.

terms.title: Elastic Supply
terms.summary: A monetary policy where token supply automatically adjusts based on economic conditions and demand.

terms.title: Explorer
terms.summary: Explorer refers to the SORA blockchain explorer experiences that let anyone browse blocks, transactions, governance queues, and validator stats in real time.

terms.title: Fearless Wallet
terms.summary: Fearless Wallet is a mobile-first application by SORAMITSU that lets users manage Polkadot, Kusama, and SORA assets with staking, swaps, and governance support.

terms.title: Governance
terms.summary: The system of decision-making and rule enforcement in blockchain networks.

terms.title: HASHI
terms.summary: SORA's decentralized and trustless cross-chain bridge that enables secure asset transfers between Ethereum and SORA networks.

terms.title: Hyperledger
terms.summary: Hyperledger is the Linux Foundation’s family of enterprise blockchain frameworks, including Hyperledger Iroha which powers SORA’s regulated deployments.

terms.title: Interoperability
terms.summary: Interoperability is the ability for SORA assets and smart contracts to communicate with other networks through bridges, XCM, APIs, or shared standards.

terms.title: Iroha
terms.summary: An open-source, permissioned blockchain framework developed by SORAMITSU and part of the Hyperledger Foundation.

terms.title: Iroha 3
terms.summary: Hyperledger Iroha 3 is the next-generation blockchain framework being developed for SORA v3 (Nexus).

terms.title: Kensetsu
terms.summary: The Kensetsu Platform is SORA's version of MakerDAO, a decentralized finance (DeFi) solution on the SORA network that enables over-collateralized stablecoin…

terms.title: KUSD
terms.summary: Kensetsu USD (KUSD) is an over-collateralized, algorithmically governed stablecoin built on the SORA network, pegged to the US Dollar.

terms.title: Liquidity
terms.summary: The availability of assets for trading without significantly affecting their price.

terms.title: Marketplace
terms.summary: Marketplace describes curated hubs where builders showcase SORA-based products, liquidity programs, or governance proposals for community discovery.

terms.title: Mobile
terms.summary: Mobile captures SORA’s focus on delivering wallets and dApps with native iOS and Android experiences so users can onboard anywhere.

terms.title: NFT
terms.summary: Non-Fungible Token - a unique digital asset that represents ownership of a specific item or piece of content on the blockchain.

terms.title: Parachain
terms.summary: A parallel blockchain in the Polkadot ecosystem that connects to the main relay chain and benefits from shared security.

terms.title: Parliament
terms.summary: The future democratic governance system of SORA using multi-body sortition with clear separation of powers.

terms.title: Payments
terms.summary: Payments covers the QR, CBDC, and merchant integrations that let SORA technology power day-to-day transactions and cross-border settlements.

terms.title: Polkaswap
terms.summary: A next-generation, cross-chain liquidity aggregator DEX protocol built on SORA network.

terms.title: Proposal
terms.summary: A proposal is a formal request submitted to SORA governance for funding, parameter changes, or new initiatives that citizens can evaluate.

terms.title: PSWAP
terms.summary: A deflationary token used to reward liquidity providers on Polkaswap.

terms.title: Real-World Assets
terms.summary: Real-world assets (RWAs) are tangible or regulated assets that become programmable once they are tokenized.

terms.title: Referendum
terms.summary: A Democracy Referendum in SORA's current governance system (Polkadot v1 Governance, also called Governance V1).

terms.title: Roadmap
terms.summary: The roadmap outlines upcoming SORA releases, TON integrations, and ecosystem milestones so contributors share the same delivery plan.

terms.title: Security
terms.summary: The protection of blockchain networks against attacks and malicious behavior.

terms.title: SORA
terms.summary: SORA is a decentralized economic network focused on programmable finance, democratic governance, and CBDC-grade infrastructure.

terms.title: SORA Card
terms.summary: A decentralized debit card that allows users to spend their cryptocurrency in the real world.

terms.title: SORA Council
terms.summary: TODO

terms.title: SORA Parliament
terms.summary: TODO

terms.title: Stablecoin
terms.summary: A stablecoin is a digital asset engineered to hold a predictable value, such as KUSD or future SORA settlement tokens used for payments.

terms.title: Staking
terms.summary: The process of locking tokens to support network security and earn rewards.

terms.title: Substrate
terms.summary: A modular blockchain framework developed by Parity Technologies.

terms.title: TBCD
terms.summary: Token Bonding Curve Dollar (TBCD) is an algorithmic, non-synthetic stablecoin whose value is maintained by the SORA token bonding curve at approximately $1 USD.

terms.title: Telegram
terms.summary: Telegram is the primary chat channel where the SORA community coordinates releases, support, validator updates, and governance calls.

terms.title: Token Bonding Curve
terms.summary: TODO

terms.title: Tokenization
terms.summary: Tokenization abstracts ownership or utility into blockchain-based tokens that can be traded, fractionally owned, or used as collateral.

terms.title: Tokenomics
terms.summary: Tokenomics explains how XOR, VAL, PSWAP, and related assets are minted, burned, bonded, or rewarded to align incentives with long-term growth.

terms.title: TON
terms.summary: TON (The Open Network) is a Telegram-backed blockchain known for high throughput and mobile-native UX that now powers TONSwap’s SORA-linked DeFi.

terms.title: TONSwap
terms.summary: A next-generation decentralized exchange (DEX) and launchpad built on The Open Network (TON) blockchain.

terms.title: VAL
terms.summary: A validator reward token for the SORA network used to reward validators and stake nominators.

terms.title: Validator
terms.summary: A network participant that validates transactions and maintains the blockchain.

terms.title: Voting
terms.summary: Voting is the act of citizens or stakeholders signaling support for SORA governance proposals through on-chain referenda or delegated councils.

terms.title: Wallet
terms.summary: A wallet is the software that stores keys, signs transactions, and connects users to SORA DeFi apps such as Polkaswap, Fearless Wallet, or TONSwap.

terms.title: XOR
terms.summary: The network utility token used for transaction fees (gas) where 50% of fees are burned and 50% go to validators.
